author: Seuthy
body:
Hello Avicadians,

Today has been a sad day known to many, our dear friend, minertedtoad, has passed on, to another server. He has contributed so much to the server, it is extremely sad to see him leave. Remember to keep him forever in your hearts as a player who changed the server. 


Lets not forget, XtraMajestical MAY be the cause of this tragedy. Here is my evidence:

[CHAT] «MOD |  XtraMajestical?» minertedtoad please can you leave


All your fault, just because he took it too seriously, he is gone. {tag=b8ee253714ff484dae1d8146fcfa8fe1}

Here is this picture to remember him.
